record.bible_text: The word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068> came again unto me, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,
Son<WH01121> of man<WH0120>, there were two<WH08147> women<WH0802>, the daughters<WH01323> of one<WH0259> mother<WH0517>:

And they committed whoredoms<WH02181><WTH8799> in Egypt<WH04714>; they committed whoredoms<WH02181><WTH8804> in their youth<WH05271>: there were their breasts<WH07699> pressed<WH04600><WTH8795>, and there they bruised<WH06213><WTH8765> the teats<WH01717> of their virginity<WH01331>.

And the names<WH08034> of them <FI>were<Fi> Aholah<WH0170> the elder<WH01419>, and Aholibah<WH0172> her sister<WH0269>: and they were mine, and they bare<WH03205><WTH8799> sons<WH01121> and daughters<WH01323>. Thus <FI>were<Fi> their names<WH08034>; Samaria<WH08111> <FI>is<Fi> Aholah<WH0170>, and Jerusalem<WH03389> Aholibah<WH0172>. <RF>Aholah: that is, His tent, or, tabernacle<Rf> <RF>Aholibah: that is, My tabernacle in her<Rf>

And Aholah<WH0170> played the harlot<WH02181><WTH8799> when she was mine<WH08478>; and she doted<WH05689><WTH8799> on her lovers<WH0157><WTH8764>, on the Assyrians<WH0804> <FI>her<Fi> neighbours<WH07138>,

<FI> Which were<Fi> clothed<WH03847><WTH8803> with blue<WH08504>, captains<WH06346> and rulers<WH05461>, all of them desirable<WH02531> young men<WH0970>, horsemen<WH06571> riding<WH07392><WTH8802> upon horses<WH05483>.

Thus she committed<WH05414><WTH8799> her whoredoms<WH08457> with them, with all them <FI>that were<Fi> the chosen<WH04005> men<WH01121> of Assyria<WH0804>, and with all on whom she doted<WH05689><WTH8804>: with all their idols<WH01544> she defiled<WH02930><WTH8738> herself. <RF>committed...: Heb. bestowed her whoredoms upon them<Rf> <RF>the chosen...: Heb. the choice of the children of Asshur<Rf>

Neither left<WH05800><WTH8804> she her whoredoms<WH08457> <FI>brought<Fi> from Egypt<WH04714>: for in her youth<WH05271> they lay<WH07901><WTH8804> with her, and they bruised<WH06213><WTH8765> the breasts<WH01717> of her virginity<WH01331>, and poured<WH08210><WTH8799> their whoredom<WH08457> upon her.

Wherefore I have delivered<WH05414><WTH8804> her into the hand<WH03027> of her lovers<WH0157><WTH8764>, into the hand<WH03027> of the Assyrians<WH01121><WH0804>, upon whom she doted<WH05689><WTH8804>.

These discovered<WH01540><WTH8765> her nakedness<WH06172>: they took<WH03947><WTH8804> her sons<WH01121> and her daughters<WH01323>, and slew<WH02026><WTH8804> her with the sword<WH02719>: and she became famous<WH08034> among women<WH0802>; for they had executed<WH06213><WTH8804> judgment<WH08196> upon her. <RF>famous: Heb. a name<Rf><CM>

And when her sister<WH0269> Aholibah<WH0172> saw<WH07200><WTH8799> <FI>this<Fi> , she was more corrupt<WH07843><WTH8686> in her inordinate love<WH05691> than she, and in her whoredoms<WH08457> more than her sister<WH0269> in <FI>her<Fi> whoredoms<WH02183>. <RF>she was...: Heb. she corrupted her inordinate love more than, etc<Rf> <RF>more than...: Heb. more than the whoredoms of her sister<Rf>

She doted<WH05689><WTH8804> upon the Assyrians<WH01121><WH0804> <FI>her<Fi> neighbours<WH07138>, captains<WH06346> and rulers<WH05461> clothed<WH03847><WTH8803> most gorgeously<WH04358>, horsemen<WH06571> riding<WH07392><WTH8802> upon horses<WH05483>, all of them desirable<WH02531> young men<WH0970>.
Then I saw<WH07200><WTH8799> that she was defiled<WH02930><WTH8738>, <FI>that<Fi> they <FI>took<Fi> both<WH08147> one<WH0259> way<WH01870>,

And <FI>that<Fi> she increased<WH03254><WTH8686> her whoredoms<WH08457>: for when she saw<WH07200><WTH8799> men<WH0582> pourtrayed<WH02707><WTH8794> upon the wall<WH07023>, the images<WH06754> of the Chaldeans<WH03778> pourtrayed<WH02710><WTH8803> with vermilion<WH08350>,

Girded<WH02289> with girdles<WH0232> upon their loins<WH04975>, exceeding<WH05628><WTH8803> in dyed attire<WH02871> upon their heads<WH07218>, all of them princes<WH07991> to look to<WH04758>, after the manner<WH01823> of the Babylonians<WH01121><WH0894> of Chaldea<WH03778>, the land<WH0776> of their nativity<WH04138>:

And as soon as she saw<WH04758> them with her eyes<WH05869>, she doted<WH05689><WTH8799> upon them, and sent<WH07971><WTH8799> messengers<WH04397> unto them into Chaldea<WH03778>. <RF>as soon...: Heb. at the sight of her eyes<Rf>

And the Babylonians<WH01121><WH0894> came<WH0935><WTH8799> to her into the bed<WH04904> of love<WH01730>, and they defiled<WH02930><WTH8762> her with their whoredom<WH08457>, and she was polluted<WH02930><WTH8799> with them, and her mind<WH05315> was alienated<WH03363><WTH8799> from them. <RF>Babylonians: Heb. children of Babel<Rf> <RF>alienated: Heb. loosed, or, disjointed<Rf>

So she discovered<WH01540><WTH8762> her whoredoms<WH08457>, and discovered<WH01540><WTH8762> her nakedness<WH06172>: then my mind<WH05315> was alienated<WH03363><WTH8799> from her, like as my mind<WH05315> was alienated<WH05361><WTH8804> from her sister<WH0269>.

Yet she multiplied<WH07235><WTH8686> her whoredoms<WH08457>, in calling to remembrance<WH02142><WTH8800> the days<WH03117> of her youth<WH05271>, wherein she had played the harlot<WH02181><WTH8804> in the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714>.

For she doted<WH05689><WTH8799> upon their paramours<WH06370>, whose flesh<WH01320> <FI>is as<Fi> the flesh<WH01320> of asses<WH02543>, and whose issue<WH02231> <FI>is like<Fi> the issue<WH02231> of horses<WH05483>.

Thus thou calledst to remembrance<WH06485><WTH8799> the lewdness<WH02154> of thy youth<WH05271>, in bruising<WH06213><WTH8800> thy teats<WH01717> by the Egyptians<WH04714> for the paps<WH07699> of thy youth<WH05271>.<CM>

Therefore, O Aholibah<WH0172>, thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; Behold, I will raise up<WH05782><WTH8688> thy lovers<WH0157><WTH8764> against thee, from whom thy mind<WH05315> is alienated<WH05361><WTH8804>, and I will bring<WH0935><WTH8689> them against thee on every side<WH05439>;

The Babylonians<WH01121><WH0894>, and all the Chaldeans<WH03778>, Pekod<WH06489>, and Shoa<WH07772>, and Koa<WH06970>, <FI>and<Fi> all the Assyrians<WH01121><WH0804> with them: all of them desirable<WH02531> young men<WH0970>, captains<WH06346> and rulers<WH05461>, great lords<WH07991> and renowned<WH07121><WTH8803>, all of them riding<WH07392><WTH8802> upon horses<WH05483>.

And they shall come<WH0935><WTH8804> against thee with chariots<WH02021>, wagons<WH07393>, and wheels<WH01534>, and with an assembly<WH06951> of people<WH05971>, <FI>which<Fi> shall set<WH07760><WTH8799> against thee buckler<WH06793> and shield<WH04043> and helmet<WH06959> round about<WH05439>: and I will set<WH05414><WTH8804> judgment<WH04941> before<WH06440> them, and they shall judge<WH08199><WTH8804> thee according to their judgments<WH04941>.

And I will set<WH05414><WTH8804> my jealousy<WH07068> against thee, and they shall deal<WH06213><WTH8804> furiously<WH02534> with thee: they shall take away<WH05493><WTH8686> thy nose<WH0639> and thine ears<WH0241>; and thy remnant<WH0319> shall fall<WH05307><WTH8799> by the sword<WH02719>: they shall take<WH03947><WTH8799> thy sons<WH01121> and thy daughters<WH01323>; and thy residue<WH0319> shall be devoured<WH0398><WTH8735> by the fire<WH0784>.
They shall also strip<WH06584><WTH8689> thee out of thy clothes<WH0899>, and take away<WH03947><WTH8804> thy fair<WH08597> jewels<WH03627>. <RF>fair...: Heb. instruments of thy decking<Rf>

Thus will I make thy lewdness<WH02154> to cease<WH07673><WTH8689> from thee, and thy whoredom<WH02184> <FI>brought<Fi> from the land<WH0776> of Egypt<WH04714>: so that thou shalt not lift up<WH05375><WTH8799> thine eyes<WH05869> unto them, nor remember<WH02142><WTH8799> Egypt<WH04714> any more.

For thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; Behold, I will deliver<WH05414><WTH8802> thee into the hand<WH03027> <FI>of them<Fi> whom thou hatest<WH08130><WTH8804>, into the hand<WH03027> <FI>of them<Fi> from whom thy mind<WH05315> is alienated<WH05361><WTH8804>:

And they shall deal<WH06213><WTH8804> with thee hatefully<WH08135>, and shall take away<WH03947><WTH8804> all thy labour<WH03018>, and shall leave<WH05800><WTH8804> thee naked<WH05903> and bare<WH06181>: and the nakedness<WH06172> of thy whoredoms<WH02183> shall be discovered<WH01540><WTH8738>, both thy lewdness<WH02154> and thy whoredoms<WH08457>.

I will do<WH06213><WTH8800> these <FI>things<Fi> unto thee, because thou hast gone a whoring<WH02181><WTH8800> after<WH0310> the heathen<WH01471>, <FI>and<Fi> because thou art polluted<WH02930><WTH8738> with their idols<WH01544>.
Thou hast walked<WH01980><WTH8804> in the way<WH01870> of thy sister<WH0269>; therefore will I give<WH05414><WTH8804> her cup<WH03563> into thine hand<WH03027>.

Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; Thou shalt drink<WH08354><WTH8799> of thy sister's<WH0269> cup<WH03563> deep<WH06013> and large<WH07342>: thou shalt be laughed to scorn<WH06712> and had in derision<WH03933>; it containeth<WH03557><WTH8687> much<WH04767>.

Thou shalt be filled<WH04390><WTH8735> with drunkenness<WH07943> and sorrow<WH03015>, with the cup<WH03563> of astonishment<WH08047> and desolation<WH08077>, with the cup<WH03563> of thy sister<WH0269> Samaria<WH08111>.

Thou shalt even drink<WH08354><WTH8804> it and suck <FI>it<Fi> out<WH04680><WTH8804>, and thou shalt break<WH01633><WTH8762> the sherds<WH02789> thereof, and pluck off<WH05423><WTH8762> thine own breasts<WH07699>: for I have spoken<WH01696><WTH8765> <FI>it<Fi> , saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>.

Therefore thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; Because thou hast forgotten<WH07911><WTH8804> me, and cast<WH07993><WTH8686> me behind<WH0310> thy back<WH01458>, therefore bear<WH05375><WTH8798> thou also thy lewdness<WH02154> and thy whoredoms<WH08457>.<CM>

The LORD<WH03068> said<WH0559><WTH8799> moreover unto me; Son<WH01121> of man<WH0120>, wilt thou judge<WH08199><WTH8799> Aholah<WH0170> and Aholibah<WH0172>? yea, declare<WH05046><WTH8685> unto them their abominations<WH08441>; <RF>judge: or, plead for<Rf>

That they have committed adultery<WH05003><WTH8765>, and blood<WH01818> <FI>is<Fi> in their hands<WH03027>, and with their idols<WH01544> have they committed adultery<WH05003><WTH8765>, and have also caused their sons<WH01121>, whom they bare<WH03205><WTH8804> unto me, to pass for them through<WH05674><WTH8689> <FI>the fire<Fi> , to devour<WH0402> <FI>them<Fi> .
Moreover this they have done<WH06213><WTH8804> unto me: they have defiled<WH02930><WTH8765> my sanctuary<WH04720> in the same day<WH03117>, and have profaned<WH02490><WTH8765> my sabbaths<WH07676>.

For when they had slain<WH07819><WTH8800> their children<WH01121> to their idols<WH01544>, then they came<WH0935><WTH8799> the same day<WH03117> into my sanctuary<WH04720> to profane<WH02490><WTH8763> it; and, lo, thus have they done<WH06213><WTH8804> in the midst<WH08432> of mine house<WH01004>.

And furthermore<WH0637>, that ye have sent<WH07971><WTH8799> for men<WH0582> to come<WH0935><WTH8802> from far<WH04801>, unto whom a messenger<WH04397> <FI>was<Fi> sent<WH07971><WTH8803>; and, lo, they came<WH0935><WTH8804>: for whom thou didst wash<WH07364><WTH8804> thyself, paintedst<WH03583><WTH8804> thy eyes<WH05869>, and deckedst<WH05710><WTH8804> thyself with ornaments<WH05716>, <RF>to come: Heb. coming<Rf>

And satest<WH03427><WTH8804> upon a stately<WH03520> bed<WH04296>, and a table<WH07979> prepared<WH06186><WTH8803> before<WH06440> it, whereupon thou hast set<WH07760><WTH8804> mine incense<WH07004> and mine oil<WH08081>. <RF>stately: Heb. honourable<Rf>

And a voice<WH06963> of a multitude<WH01995> being at ease<WH07961> <FI>was<Fi> with her: and with the men<WH0582> of the common sort<WH07230><WH0120> <FI>were<Fi> brought<WH0935><WTH8716> Sabeans<WH05436><WTH8675><WH05433><WTH8802> from the wilderness<WH04057>, which put<WH05414><WTH8799> bracelets<WH06781> upon their hands<WH03027>, and beautiful<WH08597> crowns<WH05850> upon their heads<WH07218>. <RF>of the...: Heb. of the multitude of men<Rf> <RF>Sabeans: or, drunkards<Rf>

Then said<WH0559><WTH8799> I unto <FI>her that was<Fi> old<WH01087> in adulteries<WH05004>, Will they now commit<WH02181><WTH8799> whoredoms<WH08457> with her, and she <FI>with them<Fi> ? <RF>whoredoms...: Heb. her whoredoms<Rf>

Yet they went in<WH0935><WTH8799> unto her, as they go in<WH0935><WTH8800> unto a woman<WH0802> that playeth the harlot<WH02181><WTH8802>: so went they in<WH0935><WTH8804> unto Aholah<WH0170> and unto Aholibah<WH0172>, the lewd<WH02154> women<WH0802>.

And the righteous<WH06662> men<WH0582>, they shall judge<WH08199><WTH8799> them after the manner<WH04941> of adulteresses<WH05003><WTH8802>, and after the manner<WH04941> of women that shed<WH08210><WTH8802> blood<WH01818>; because they <FI>are<Fi>  adulteresses<WH05003><WTH8802>, and blood<WH01818> <FI>is<Fi> in their hands<WH03027>.

For thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; I will bring up<WH05927><WTH8687> a company<WH06951> upon them, and will give<WH05414><WTH8800> them to be removed<WH02189> and spoiled<WH0957>. <RF>to be...: Heb. for a removing and spoil<Rf>

And the company<WH06951> shall stone<WH07275><WTH8804> them with stones<WH068>, and dispatch<WH01254><WTH8763> them with their swords<WH02719>; they shall slay<WH02026><WTH8799> their sons<WH01121> and their daughters<WH01323>, and burn up<WH08313><WTH8799> their houses<WH01004> with fire<WH0784>. <RF>dispatch...: or, single them out<Rf>

Thus will I cause lewdness<WH02154> to cease<WH07673><WTH8689> out of the land<WH0776>, that all women<WH0802> may be taught<WH03256><WTH8739> not to do<WH06213><WTH8799> after your lewdness<WH02154>.

And they shall recompense<WH05414><WTH8804> your lewdness<WH02154> upon you, and ye shall bear<WH05375><WTH8799> the sins<WH02399> of your idols<WH01544>: and ye shall know<WH03045><WTH8804> that I <FI>am<Fi> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>.<CM>
